_comment: Screening test G3: identical hyperparameters, dev folds and protocol to the calibration refits, with PRESENCE/ABSENCE features (fraction binarised at >0, MUSET's own definition of k-mer presence) instead of the k-mer completeness fraction. The calibration refits ARE the fraction baseline on exactly these folds, so the comparison is like-for-like. Hyperparameters were tuned for fraction and are NOT re-searched, which handicaps presence/absence -- though less than it handicapped log1p(abundance), since both stay in [0,1]. Five folds resolve about +/-0.05 to 0.10 on the paired difference, so a null result means NOT RESOLVABLE, not NO DIFFERENCE. Held-out is not touched.
